facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia issued Regulation CBL/RSD/004/2020 on consumer protection and market conduct on 8 January 2020, taking effect on Gazette publication, applying to all regulated financial institutions and including e-banking security duties and digital credit disclosure rules (credit up to US$33).
facts.system: Regulations Concerning Consumer Protection and Market Conduct (CBL/RSD/004/2020)

facts.fact: The regulation requires each financial institution to run a consumer help desk and lets a dissatisfied consumer escalate to the Consumer Protection Unit of the Central Bank of Liberia's Regulation and Supervision Department, which must respond within one month.
facts.system: Consumer Protection Unit, Central Bank of Liberia

systems.system: Regulations Concerning Consumer Protection and Market Conduct (CBL/RSD/004/2020)

note: The regulation provides for fines of at least LRD 100,000 but reports none imposed, so no enforced fact.
